title: Add tests
purpose: Add or move requested tests into this analytical batch. Approved work is marked Reanalysis and keeps its earlier approval until a new revision is entered.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: These are staff pages. Active users with an application staff role can read them; client accounts cannot. Analysts perform result entry and batch work, reviewers decide results, and administrators maintain configuration. Administrators also have operational analyst and reviewer access, but independence rules still apply. Superuser status alone does not grant an application role.

sections.title: Eligibility
paragraphs: Candidates have an active definition for this exact method/version and matrix, matching sample matrix, no receipt Hold or Reject, no disposal and no active external dispatch. Tests already here or with entered/submitted revisions are excluded. Unassigned, awaiting, returned and approved work can appear. Preparation chronology and all eligibility rules are rechecked on save. Closed batches show a notice without add controls.

items.label: Search
items.description: Partial, case-insensitive lab ID, client sample ID or analyte.

items.label: Kind of work
items.description: All includes unfinished work and approved reanalysis. Not yet analysed excludes approved results but can include returned work. Reanalysis includes approved results only.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Expand Client.

items.label: Client
items.description: Limit candidates to one client across its projects.

items.label: Sample
items.description: Lab ID opening the sample.

items.label: Currently
items.description: Not in a batch, current batch/status, or Reanalysis and the batch where its latest result was approved.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Requested analyte; method and matrix appear above the table.

items.label: Client / project
items.description: Order’s client and project.

items.label: Collected
items.description: Collection event used by collection clocks; composite end where applicable.

items.label: Hold deadline
items.description: Shortest active collection-start deadline and any running warning/time remaining. Approved work has no running entry clock.

items.label: Received
items.description: Receipt date/time; hidden initially.

items.label: Select all tests on this page
items.description: Check all visible candidates, including Reanalysis. Selection is limited to this page.

items.label: Select only new work
items.description: Check visible candidates that are not approved; excludes Reanalysis rows.

items.label: What happens to a Reanalysis test
items.description: Expand the explanation of preserved approval and new-review requirements.

items.label: Add selected to
items.description: Analysts add the checked tests to this open batch. A failed or changed selection rejects the whole assignment. Already-assigned tests are skipped. Moves are audited with their prior batch.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Return to the batch without assigning work.

sections.title: Filtering and table controls

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters to the entire matching dataset and return to page 1. Invalid filters show errors and no rows; they never widen the query.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search and filters and restore this page’s defaults. A filter chip removes only that filter.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: Choose 25 (default), 50 or 100. First, Previous, Next and Last page links retain filters. Counts describe all matching records.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show or hide optional columns and change their order using movement controls or header dragging. Changes apply immediately and are saved for this table in this browser. Locked columns stay available.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restore the original column visibility and order. Done or Close dismisses the Columns dialog.

paragraphs: Fixed oldest collection first, then lab ID and analyte. No sortable column headings.

sections.title: Reanalysis and history
paragraphs: Moving an approved result changes current batch assignment, preserving the old approved revision and issued reports. Use the result page or import with a reason to enter its next revision; the ordinary entry grid excludes approved results. Submit it for independent review under the new batch’s QC. Historical source-batch QC obligations remain after movement. If no eligible tests appear, resolve the stated eligibility restrictions; clear filters for a filtered empty result.
